title: Bias-Corrected Ceilings of Emotion Predictability from Human Label Variation Based on Instance-Level Fano Bounds
abstract: arXiv:2608.15619v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Emotion recognition from text keeps improving on benchmarks, yet whether an accuracy ceiling has been reached is seldom asked with discipline. Our aim is not to pin this ceiling to a single number, but to quantify how far it depends on finite annotation, estimator choice, annotation noise, and the evaluation protocol, and thereby to discipline how confidently saturation can be claimed. We propose Bias-corrected Affective Ceiling Estimation (BACE), an analysis framework that estimates a bias-corrected ceiling, separates irreducible from reducible error, and disciplines the resulting claims. An anchored Dirichlet-mixture empirical Bayes estimator, bracketed between plug-in and NSB, recovers the human-consensus distribution; an annotator split, a noise deconvolution, and a fixed claim gate then attribute error without circularity. translated_title: 基于实例级Fano界限的人类标签变异情绪可预测性偏差校正上限
translated_abstract: 文本情绪识别在基准测试上持续改进，然而，是否已达到准确率上限很少被严谨地追问。我们的目标并非将此上限固定为一个数字，而是量化其多大程度上依赖于有限标注、估计器选择、标注噪声和评估协议，从而规范地判断饱和状态的可信度。我们提出偏差校正情感上限估计（BACE），这是一个分析框架，用于估计偏差校正后的上限，区分不可约误差与可约误差，并规范由此产生的声明。一种锚定狄利克雷混合经验贝叶斯估计器（介于插件法和NSB之间）恢复了人类共识分布；通过标注者划分、噪声去卷积和固定声明门控，无循环地将误差归因。方法论上，无约束点估计将可达性置于0.38至1.03之间，因此饱和状态需谨慎声明。
tldr: 本文提出BACE框架，通过偏差校正和误差分解，严谨估计情绪识别准确率上限，避免对饱和状态的过度自信。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the BACE framework to rigorously estimate the emotion recognition accuracy ceiling via bias correction and error decomposition, preventing overconfident saturation claims.
